limitations: Staged recipes, not a pure timestep causal comparison. A/B use different independently trained actors and action-rate weights.
B→C is the same frozen actor: both integration and explicit PD update rate change200→400Hz; policy remains50Hz.
D is a new from-scratch400Hz cohort with a shared mjlab-style DR recipe, unlike the historical BeyondMimic-style DR in A/B/C.
Original grounded+0.4 is unchanged in all four stages. No dense-contact reward, target low-pass filter or extra torque-rate reward is included.
One seed/episode per stage; no statistical or hardware-stability claim.50Hz video cannot resolve all native200/400Hz jitter.
Native poses/heights/falls are unchanged. Native contact counts/Fz are diagnostics; zero does not establish geometric flight.
One camera distance for all350frames/allfourcases, fixed root-relative offset and world orientation. Fixed world maps retain XY drift.
Reference ends6.96s; XY tracking is unavailable beyond it, with no endpoint extrapolation.

definitions.beta: COM course minus projected body+X; wrapped error against intended nonzero reference; speed/axis validity retained
definitions.jitter: World angular X/Y channel-mean RMS, linear detrend/Hann/Parseval, strictly10<f<100Hz at each actual native rate
definitions.load_eligibility: Recorded ground-contact count>0 AND world ground-normal Fz>5N, separately per wheel
definitions.duty: Time-weighted native zero-order hold, sum(mask[:-1]*diff(time))/(last-first); not sample mean
definitions.failure_gates: No height, tilt, zero-load or nonzero-beta failure gate; contact is diagnostic only

limitations: A/B are independently retrained historical200Hz checkpoints; one seed is not a statistical causal action-weight effect.
B/C reuse one frozen200Hz-trained actor and change deployment physics AND explicitPD rate; policy stays50Hz and closed-loop actions can differ.
D is retrained400Hz with shared representable MJLab-style DR and setup/reseed ordering, unlike historicalDR/setup. It does not isolate training frequency or contact handling.
All four keep the ORIGINAL last-substep grounded+0.4 reward. No trained400Hz dense-contact replacement is available.
Equal nominalmu does not calibrate different material mappings/contact laws; contact sample/history horizons also change with native rate.
Full6.98s tracking is unavailable beyond the6.96s reference; reference_overlap is separate and no extrapolation is used.
Similar XY does not establish equivalent dynamics, low jitter or stable continuous contact. Zero measured load is not a flight label.

historical_contact_negative.scope: Separate200Hz reward-function replacement at unchanged+0.4; never a fifth main400Hz stage

compact_signal_bundle.scope: Compact original numeric signals permit metric review, not independent reproduction of the strict source/metadata verification.
